mapper.select: select b.user_code from yh_user_make_card as a left join yh_user_admin_info as b on a.doctor=b.id where a.user_code=#{usercode}

SELECT e.type, d.doc_id AS docId, IF ( f.post_code IS NOT NULL AND f.post_code != '', f.post_code, IF ( f.gender, 'https://yjyqny.yhy.ren/new/maleDoctor.png', 'https://yjyqny.yhy.ren/new/femaleDoctor.png' ) ) AS postCode, f.gender, e.info FROM cs_org_doctor_chat AS d LEFT JOIN cs_doctor_chat_list AS e ON d.type = e.id LEFT JOIN yh_user_make_card AS b ON d.doc_id = b.User_Code LEFT JOIN yh_user_admin_info AS i ON b.doctor = i.id LEFT JOIN yh_org_tree AS c ON b.Org_Id = c.Org_Code LEFT JOIN yh_user_reginfo AS f ON d.doc_id = f.user_code WHERE d.org_id =( SELECT user_code FROM yh_org_tree WHERE org_code =( SELECT Org_Id FROM yh_user_make_card WHERE User_Code = #{usercode} ))

SELECT e.type, d.doc_id AS docId, IF ( f.post_code IS NOT NULL AND f.post_code != '', f.post_code, IF ( f.gender, 'https://yjyqny.yhy.ren/new/maleDoctor.png', 'https://yjyqny.yhy.ren/new/femaleDoctor.png' ) ) AS postCode, f.gender, e.info FROM cs_org_doctor_chat AS d LEFT JOIN cs_doctor_chat_list AS e ON d.type = e.id LEFT JOIN yh_user_make_card AS b ON d.doc_id = b.User_Code LEFT JOIN yh_user_admin_info AS i ON b.doctor = i.id LEFT JOIN yh_org_tree AS c ON b.Org_Id = c.Org_Code LEFT JOIN yh_user_reginfo AS f ON d.doc_id = f.user_code WHERE d.org_id = 'OR100'
